preconditions.description: Attacker must be the owner of the contract.
The contract must have a balance of its own token, which is accumulated from taxes.

exploit_hint: As the owner, the attacker can first call `setMarketingWallet` to designate their own address as the recipient of funds. Subsequently, calling `getAllTaxes()` will trigger the contract to swap its entire token balance for the native currency (BNB) and transfer it to the attacker's address.
